title: Paid by two unrelated funded organizations in the same tax year
question: Who is listed with pay of $25,000 or more on the returns of two City-funded organizations that do not report each other as related, in the same year?
finding: 21 names are paid by two unrelated funded organizations in one tax year; 4 in two or more years. In 10 both returns give 35 hours a week or more and neither title notes a part year. Most are what a job change looks like; on this test little unusual was found.
how: Part VII of every return of a profiled organization: the same first and last name with $25,000 or more from each of two organizations in tax years ending in the same calendar year, the two not tied by Schedule R.
limits: A return lists a person for the whole year even if they left in the second month, so a mid-year move shows as two full-time jobs. Two people can share a name. Pay from a related organization is already on the pay screens and is left out here.
